changeset-claim-re-read

## ⚠️ 4 pending changeset(s) describe a file this change touches

Their bodies publish **verbatim** into the CHANGELOG at the next release, so this is a request to **re-read them against your diff** — addressed here because you are the one seat that can answer it without re-deriving anything.

⛔ Nothing here blocks, and nothing here is a verdict on your change. This gate exits 0, is not a required context, and judges **name resolution, never meaning**: it asked whether a pending body names a file you touched. "Is this sentence still true?" is the one question it will not answer, and the one you are being asked to answer.

### `.changeset/6310-designer-formula-key-retired.md`

- names `packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/i18n.ts` → `packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/i18n.ts` — edited by this change

  > Not touched: `designer.field.formula` (`'Formula (CEL)'`) in `packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/i18n.ts`, a different and live key belonging to metadata-admin's `ObjectFieldInspector` — the surface that still authors formula expressions.

### `.changeset/6329-actionparam-one-authority.md`

- names `ActionDefaultInspector.tsx` → `packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/inspectors/ActionDefaultInspector.tsx` — edited by this change

  > `ActionParam` has one authority again (objectui#6329). The name was declared three times, not twice as the card counted: `@object-ui/types` publishes it — derived from the spec's `ActionParamSchema` input, with its own parity suite — and `ActionDefaultInspector.tsx` and `ActionPreview.tsx` each carried a module-local `interface` of the same name. app-shell already read the published one elsewhere (`utils/resolveActionParams.test.ts`), so both locals were shadows. They are deleted, not reconciled against each other, under the 2026-08-25 family ruling 甲A1.

### `.changeset/7125-dashboard-empty-state-keys-retired.md`

- names `packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/i18n.ts` → `packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/i18n.ts` — edited by this change

  > Not touched: `table.noRows` (`'No rows to display'`) and `engine.form.noRows` (`packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/i18n.ts`, read at `widgets.tsx`) — two different, same-named keys in different namespaces. Nor the comments in `WidgetEmptyState.tsx`, `DatasetWidget.tsx`, `ObjectDataTable.tsx` and `PivotTable.tsx` that record WHY three widgets with three strings became one shared empty state; the packs' own comment keeps that rationale and now names the retirement instead of a row that is gone.

### `.changeset/8632-malformed-picklist-option-loud.md`

- names `views/metadata-admin/i18n.ts` → `packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/i18n.ts` — edited by this change

  > Two new strings land in the designer's own `en` / `zh` tables — the metadata-admin console owns its strings in `views/metadata-admin/i18n.ts` and is deliberately outside the ten locale packs (`packages/i18n/README.md`, "Scope — the `engine.*` carve-out").

Read the **paragraph**, not the line: both false halves of the objectui#8617 claim sat in one paragraph, and correcting either alone would have left it asserting the same wrong thing.

If a claim did go false, **correct the body**. That is precedented and prose-only, frontmatter untouched; `check-changeset-overwrite.mjs` will report the correction as its own case 2 ("correcting a declaration on purpose … legitimate"), which is the intended shape — one gate asks for the read, the other records the write.

Not covered, stated so nobody reads this as more: a born-false claim that spells no line address at all (objectui#9495 coordinated one by ORDINAL — "a grep finds that member first" — and deciding that means reading what the sentence means), a claim spelled as a symbol or a package rather than a backticked file name, and a file named ambiguously.

Compared the checked-out tree with `7baede374` (merge-base with origin/main): 6 file(s) changed outside `.changeset/`, read against 1516 pending declaration(s) that publish a body (2102 pending in total). · [run](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/actions/runs/36165822831)

## CI red at `7c35ba6` on the objectui#10645 test only, so this PR waits for that fix to land

`domain:ui` seat 5, `session_01KUxVUa7e39aNjhkKi1gsoy`, 2026-09-25T16:56Z. The at-tier contract review of this head PASSed; its record follows. One required check is red:
- **The check:** `Test (shard 2/8)`, with a single failing test out of 6952 in the shard: `apps/console/src/pages/developer/ApiConsolePage.requestPreset-10591.test.tsx:299`, the console still on its boot splash. That is objectui#10645.
- **Why it is not this PR's:** this PR touches only `packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/`.
- **The fix:** PR objectui#10677 carries it, and it is in the merge queue now, ACCEPTed.
- **What happens next:** once that fix is on `main`, this branch takes one `origin/main` merge, CI re-runs, and the seat re-reviews the merged head and ACCEPTs it. This PR does not widen.

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `7c35ba6f8b30997b90c73f03bdc902e6a51b4ed2`

Read for this record: card objectui#10586 (body and all 9 comments), the triage `5832133290`, the three claims `5832991567` / `5834151314` / `5834971726`, the `packages/i18n` README carve-out section (objectui#4662) the claims cite, PR objectui#10678 (body, 7-file list, check-runs at the head, three reads), the diff `02e6d3668341b231bc0009b5fa74d33d83955e33..7c35ba6f8b30997b90c73f03bdc902e6a51b4ed2` via `refs/review/pr-10678` and `refs/review/main`, AGENTS.md 版本号策略 and the changeset-presence rule, `.changeset/config.json`. The os-dev-report was not used as evidence. Zero GitHub writes. Line numbers below are at the head.

### ① Derived judgments

**Binding text.** Triage `5832133290`: 「route the strings through `engine.inspector.*` / `engine.form.*` with keys in every built-in locale; en stays byte-identical」. Claim `5834151314` reads 「keys in every built-in locale」 as the designer catalogue's two built-in locales (the objectui#4662 carve-out; the README records that no `engine.*` key exists in any of the ten packs). Claim `5834971726` file surface: `inspectors/HookDefaultInspector.tsx`, `inspectors/ActionDefaultInspector.tsx`, `inspectors/InspectorComboField.tsx` (its `searchPlaceholder` / `emptyText` defaults, the `Loading…` trigger and the `Use "…"` custom row), `inspectors/_shared.tsx` (its `Close` / `Move up` / `Move down` / `Options could not be loaded` defaults), their rows in `i18n.ts` (`ENGINE_STRINGS_EN` and `ENGINE_STRINGS_ZH`), pins beside them, one `.changeset/10586-…-2.md`; ⛔ not `packages/i18n/src/locales/`.

1. **Surface.** 7 files: the four claimed components, `metadata-admin/i18n.ts` (+325/-0), one new pin `inspectors/inspectorStrings.hookAction.i18n-10586.test.tsx` (+615), one changeset `.changeset/10586-inspector-strings-i18n-2.md` (+23). Nothing under `packages/i18n/`. Right against the claim.

2. **Catalogue rows, `i18n.ts`.** 156 new keys in each table: `engine.inspector.hook.*` 27 (EN 795–823, ZH 3039–3066), `engine.inspector.action.*` 125 (EN 824–952, ZH 3067–3194), `engine.inspector.combo.*` 4 (EN 1220–1225, ZH 3513–3517). Scanned both tables at the head on top of PR 1's rows: EN 1950 keys / 1950 unique, ZH 2005 / 2005, **0 duplicate keys**; the new EN and ZH key sets are equal; no new zh row equals its en row; every `{slot}` name set matches between en and zh. The pre-existing `hook.kind`, `action.kind`, `action.close` rows are not re-declared. Right against the triage as the carve-out ruling reads it.

3. **en byte-identical, row by row.** Every removed literal in the four components was compared with the row that replaced it at code-point level: 133 rows match a removed literal exactly by script; the remaining 25 were checked by hand because the base spelled them as multi-line JSX text or with a node inside. Multi-line JSX (`action.updateHint` 150-row, `action.noPlacement`): JSX collapses the line breaks to single spaces, and the row carries exactly that collapsed text. Slotted rows: `action.pinnedScript` (head 680) splits into "Pinned to " + the code element + the rest, the base's three children; `action.scriptBodyHint` (772) likewise around the signature code element; `action.capabilityGate` (879) with `{capabilities}` as the mono span and `{whom}` as `capabilityGateAll` "all of them" / `capabilityGateOne` "it", then `capabilityGateSelf` (887) after the same `{' '}`; the combo's `Use {value}` splits to "Use " and an empty tail (188, 233), the curly quotes staying in JSX as before. `action.removeOption` "Remove option {index}" through `tFormat` (454) yields "Remove option 1" for the base's template literal. Code points preserved: U+2014 em dashes, U+2019 apostrophes, U+2026 ellipses, U+00B7 middle dots in the location labels, U+2265 in the two AI-description rows. Reused rows equal the removed defaults byte for byte: `engine.form.selectEllipsis` "Select…", `engine.close` "Close", `engine.inspector.reorder.up` / `.down` "Move up" / "Move down", `engine.form.optionsLoadFailedTitle` "Options could not be loaded", and the new `combo.loading` "Loading…". Serialized markup is identical; the only difference is invisible text-node boundaries where the base used `{' '}` splits (the capability sentence, the three "Add …" buttons). Right.

4. **`ActionDefaultInspector.tsx`.** `KeyedOption` + `localizeOptions` (69–75) resolve option labels at render; the six option tables keep every stored `value` (87–129, 289–292). `PARAM_TYPE_OPTS` (147–156) keeps its `satisfies` check over `ResolvableParamFieldType`; `LOCATION_LABELS` (202–209) stays total over `ActionLocation` with keys as values; `TARGET_FIELD` (221–227) keys the worded placeholders and keeps the sample values `object.viewKey` and `/api/v1/…` literal; `targetCfg` (637–642) still hands `ActionTargetField` (239) plain strings, so the ` *` suffix composition is untouched. `withSlots` (81–85) is the `ResourceEditPage` split-and-interleave. `ObjectPicker` (350) and `ParamOptionsEditor` (415–420) gain a required `locale` and are passed it (664, 830); both are file-local. The per-input move buttons (807–808) reuse `engine.inspector.reorder.up` / `.down`, en identical to the removed aria-labels. 121 strings, all in the pin's `ACTION_EN`. Left literal: HTTP methods, `status` / `done` / `100`, the JS sample placeholder, the `#` counters and arrows. Right.

5. **`HookDefaultInspector.tsx`.** `BODY_LANG_OPTS` carries `labelKey` (49–52), resolved through `tr` at 304; the pre-existing `tr` (125) is the host `locale` prop. 27 sites between 215 and 390, including the answered-empty roster sentence (236) and the two body hints (322–323). The priority `100` and the expression / JS body samples (317) stay literal: not words. Right.

6. **`InspectorComboField.tsx`.** Imports `t, useMetadataLocale` (50); the three word props are renamed to `*Prop` (136–138); `useMetadataLocale()` runs unconditionally after the two `useState`s (147) and each default is `prop ?? t(key, locale)` (148–150); the loading trigger (167) and the custom row (188, 233) read the catalogue. `??` has the same undefined-only semantics as the former default parameters, and the props are typed as optional strings, so a caller's own `placeholder` / `searchPlaceholder` / `emptyText` still renders exactly. `useMetadataLocale()` is `useObjectTranslation().language` mapped to `zh-CN` / `en-US` (i18n.ts 5378–5381), the channel `InspectorSelectField`'s flag already reads (`_shared.tsx` 415): the active designer locale, not a hard-coded one. **The `placeholder` default** ("Select…") is outside the claim's enumerated list: same defect class, same signature, in a claimed file; the en text is identical (U+2026 on both sides) and a caller's placeholder wins (148). Accepted as the named deviation.

7. **`_shared.tsx`.** `InspectorShell` (60–62): `closeLabelProp ?? t('engine.close', locale)`. `InspectorReorderButtons` (106–118): the hook is read at 115 before the early return at 116, so hook order does not depend on props; labels at 117–118. `InspectorSelectField` (326, 355, 415–416): `rosterFailureLabelProp ?? t('engine.form.optionsLoadFailedTitle', locale)`. In-tree callers, verified by grep: 21 `InspectorShell` sites, 19 pass `closeLabel` and 2 `hideClose`; 5 `InspectorReorderButtons` sites, only `ObjectFieldInspector` 797–802 passes no labels; all 4 `roster=` sites pass `rosterFailureLabel`. A caller's own text is untouched. Right.

8. **Missing asks.** None: every item of claim `5834971726`'s surface is present, and no user-visible English literal remains in the four components (attribute, JSX-text and ternary sweeps at the head).

9. **Not asked.** The `placeholder` default (item 6, accepted); the two file-local helpers and the JSDoc header edits in `InspectorComboField.tsx` and `_shared.tsx`, which document the change in the claimed files. Nothing else.

10. **Existing pins.** None edited or deleted: the file list adds one test and modifies no test. The objectui#6538 pin `ActionDesigner.paramVocabulary.test.tsx:80` maps `PARAM_TYPE_OPTS` to its `.value` field only, so the `label` to `labelKey` rename does not weaken it.

11. **New pin can fail.** `inspectorStrings.hookAction.i18n-10586.test.tsx`, 11 cases.
